prompt: The sensor fleet dashboard shows a battery gauge on the node detail screen, and it has been reading low for some nodes. A field tech pulled the raw frame from one affected node: its batt field held "20", and the gauge showed 20, but the hardware team says that frame carries a charge reading of 32. The gauge gets its number from chargeLevel in src/telemetry-frame.mjs. Fix chargeLevel so the gauge shows the charge reading the frame carries. Run npm test to check the regression.
